About Me

I’m an industrial design student at Wentworth Institute of Technology in Boston, graduating in late 2028. I hope to specialize in CAD design, taking ideas from first sketches to detailed 3D models and renders.

My goals as a designer

  • Specialize in CAD design after I graduate, modeling products that are thoughtful, precise and ready to be made.
  • Design ideas that include everyone, with accessibility built in from the start.
